bio.text: Larry Rhoden, a Republican, is the 34th governor of South Dakota and is on the November 2026 ballot as the incumbent.
He was elected lieutenant governor alongside Gov. Kristi Noem in 2018 and re-elected in 2022, and became governor in January 2025 when Noem resigned.
Before that he served in the Legislature beginning in 2000, including as House majority leader, and served six years in the South Dakota National Guard after high school.
According to the governor's office, Rhoden is a lifelong West River rancher who still operates the ranch where he was born.
